instruction: Look at gui_008_sensor_mount.step in SolidWorks, a 60 x 40 x 20 mm sensor mount spanning X=-30 to X=30, Y=-20 to Y=20, and Z=0 to Z=20. At the start of the task, open SOLIDWORKS 2025 from its desktop shortcut, then load `gui_008_sensor_mount.step`. It has a centered 30 x 20 mm top rectangular recess that is initially 2 mm deep. Deepen the recess to 5 mm so the recessed floor is at Z=15, add R3 fillets to its four vertical corners, and cut a centered through cable hole of diameter 12 mm through the recess along Z. Add 1 mm chamfers to the four bottom outside perimeter edges. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_008_sensor_mount_out.step.

command: import pyautogui, time; time.sleep(20); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(5)
